claims.statement: The customer-records app entitlement cache was not invalidated after the directory sync at 02:10, causing it to serve stale cached role assignments (version 41 instead of directory version 42), resulting in 403 denials for the 214 affected users
claims.limitation: Confirmed by traces, diagnosis, and successful mitigation resolving the incident

claims.statement: Evicting entitlement entries for the 214 affected users forced the app to reload from the directory, serving correct version 42 and reducing authorization failures from 31% to 1% within 3 minutes

next_action.rationale: Root cause definitively identified and resolved: stale entitlement cache in customer-records app was serving pre-sync role data. Mitigation (cache eviction) successful, reducing error rate from 31% to 1%. No further action needed beyond normal post-incident review.
